key_insight: Phase-aggregated cost estimation helps massively parallel safe reinforcement learning reconcile short training rollouts with full-episode safety constraints.
engineering_relevance: The approach enables faster wall-clock training while retaining episode-level safety accounting in on-policy reinforcement learning.
method: Model staggered environment resets as a phase mixture of short trajectory segments.
Aggregate costs across phases to estimate full-episode costs.
Tighten constraints to account for finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch.
evidence_signal: Experiments using an MJX-based Safety Gym implementation report performance comparable to non-massively parallel implementations with substantially reduced wall-clock training time.
watch_item: Uneven phase coverage can bias cost estimates, so deployment requires careful uncertainty and distribution-mismatch handling.
paper_title: Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
